title: Game runtime status
description: B1, status up: what a game runtime reports to the control plane's status listener. World truth comes from the plugin's count of the loaded world's objects, not from container health.

generation.description: The generation the runtime is running.

state.description: installing: downloading SteamCMD or the server, or waiting to retry a download that failed. loading: launched, the world not yet reported. running: the world loaded. unverified: launched, but the plugin has not reported a world that had nothing to lose: no save, or last seen empty. held: stopped before its first autosave because the world loaded empty, or the plugin never reported it, although it held objects when last seen or, with nothing remembered, a save existed; the container stays up.

reason.description: Why the runtime is held or unverified, or why its install is being retried, in one line of printable text: vhd status shows it to the server manager.

objects.description: The loaded world's object count, as the plugin last reported it. Absent while the plugin's report is missing or stale.

players.description: Players connected, as the plugin last reported it. Absent while the plugin's report is missing or stale.

backups.description: The world's backups, as the runtime last listed its backup folder. Absent until it has.

names.description: The backups in the folder, newest first, each named for when it was taken, in UTC. At most the manifest's backups.keep and keep_daily allow together; a folder holding more, as after either is lowered, is named only as far as that.

newest_age_s.description: Seconds since the newest backup was taken. Absent with no backup.

failure.description: Why the last backup failed, in one line of printable text: vhd status shows it to the server manager. Absent once a backup succeeds.
